component.name: VY-TermWEB
component.summary: Web-based SSH/SFTP terminal and infrastructure manager

description.p: VY-TermWEB is a browser-based terminal and infrastructure manager. A single Go binary serves the full panel — SSH/SFTP sessions, a local shell, file manager, text editor, network scanner and system info — gated by a master password.

ul.li: SSH terminal sessions with resumable connections, jump hosts and L/R/SOCKS5 tunnels
SFTP file manager with remote edit, upload/download and thumbnails
Local shell (PTY) — inside Flatpak it spawns the real host shell
Local filesystem browser, Monaco/plain text editor, session logging
Network scanner (ping + TCP sweep, MAC/vendor, port scan, traceroute)
Encrypted credential vault, session groups, macros, i18n (en/pt-BR/es)
